title: AI as a Compiler: Compiling Triton kernels without the Triton compiler
abstract: arXiv:2609.36800v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compiler backends are expensive to build and maintain as programming models, workloads, and accelerators evolve. We investigate whether large language models can replace the conventional optimizing and lowering pipeline, a process that we call AI lowering. We study AI lowering from Triton to NVIDIA PTX: an LLM agent translates Triton kernels directly into PTX. We build an environment that evaluates candidate PTX, and an agentic harness in which an LLM translates Triton kernels into PTX. Across twelve common kernels on Ada, Hopper, and Blackwell GPUs and ten kernels from recent ML papers, AI lowering achieves 0.83x-3.34x the performance of autotuned Triton. The largest gains come from transformations that Triton's lowering pipeline does not perform, such as decoding packed binary weights directly into Tensor Core operands (3.34x on BitDelta), assigning each thread a complete softmax row in tensor memory (1.37x on FlashAttention), and reus

translated_title: AI作为编译器：无需Triton编译器即可编译Triton内核
translated_abstract: 随着编程模型、工作负载和加速器的不断演进，编译器后端的构建与维护成本高昂。我们研究了大型语言模型能否取代传统的优化与降级流水线，并将这一过程称为“AI降级”（AI lowering）。我们研究了从Triton到NVIDIA PTX的AI降级：由LLM智能体将Triton内核直接翻译为PTX。我们构建了一个用于评估候选PTX的环境，以及一个智能体框架，在其中LLM将Triton内核翻译为PTX。在Ada、Hopper和Blackwell GPU上的十二个常见内核以及来自近期机器学习论文的十个内核上，AI降级达到了自动调优Triton性能的0.83倍至3.34倍。最大的性能提升来自Triton降级流水线无法执行的变换，例如将打包的二进制权重直接解码为Tensor Core操作数（BitDelta上达3.34倍）、在张量内存中为每个线程分配完整的softmax行（FlashAttention上达1.37倍），以及重用……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“AI降级”方法，让大语言模型智能体直接将Triton内核翻译为NVIDIA PTX汇编代码，在多种GPU上实现了自动调优Triton性能的0.83至3.34倍，证明LLM可以替代传统编译器后端并完成Triton编译器无法实现的优化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "AI lowering," where an LLM agent directly translates Triton kernels into NVIDIA PTX, achieving 0.83x-3.34x the performance of autotuned Triton across multiple GPU architectures and demonstrating that LLMs can replace conventional compiler backends while enabling optimizations the Triton compiler cannot perform.
